name: Foosball Apartment
headline: Play Foosball & Do Yoga - 1 BR Apt. - Free Airport Pickup!
summary: This earthy & modern 1 bedroom designer apartment is located in the lively neighbourhood of Heliopolis just outside Cairo International Airport.

description.Space:
This apartment is perfect for small families and business travelers. This one bedroom apartment includes a spacious reception area with a combined living and dining room that includes a foosball table.  There is a fully equipped kitchen, cooking utensils and a coffee machine. The living room is furnished with a sofa set along with a 40 inch smart TV with Chromecast and AirPlay built-in for further personal entertainment.
The bedroom includes a king size bed & a yoga corner and access to a full bathroom with a tub. 
Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 
- Free of charge street parking is available. 
- Please be informed that there are two locked rooms in the apartment that are not accessible and contain private belongings, please use only the room advertised on the website.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment. There are two locked unused rooms.
description.Interaction: Guests can text and call us anytime they need assistance. We'll be happy to address any issues right away.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is packed with cafés and restaurants along El Nasr street which is close to the apartment. 
This neighborhood is full of life with plenty of street food options (the apartment is quite and peaceful though) 

- Banks and other services are also within walking distance. 

- Cairo Complex is within 15 min walking distance and is packed with hangouts. 
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive 
- New Cairo is a 15 min drive
- Cairo International Airport is a 5 min drive.
description.Transit:
We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours. 

All places are reachable by car, Uber app and Careem app but if you wish to take a walk it's takes no more than 5 minutes to reach any of the services around.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

 Xuru Stays

- Spacious apartment

Negative:
- The building is quite worn, so it felt immediately a bit sketchy when we where walking in the halls.
- It's a bit strange that we're asked to throw our own trash before leaving.
- It's also strange to be asked to "leave the apartment as clean as possible".
- There's an overload of information being provided by the host through the booking.com chat, which makes it hard to progress when you're on the go, stressed with commuting, and need to do this on your phone. It would be much better if they sent you a neatly organized PDF with all the info you need, highlighted with the most important to-dos.
- Could have been useful receiving information priothat only one of the two elevators  in the building will bring you to your floor.
- The bathroom is only of so-and-so quality.
- It is too hard to find the key lockbox outside as it's hidden behind some bushes. I recommend the host to clarify better where to find this lock box.
- This was our second stay with the host, having slept at a different apartment 4 nights prior. We were asked to make a deposit for this second stay, but the deposit from the previous stay had not been refunded (and the host seemed unaware that the deposit had not been refunded). It therefore became an annoying experience for us that an assistant in the building came to claim another deposit and it became a whole process of back and forth for us to sort it out. However, it all ended well, so we're overall pleased with the experience.

I just wanted to say thank you for everything, my stay was truly memorable and I am so grateful!

There were a few issues during our stay, including missing kitchen inventory, no way to hang drying laundry, and an extra duvet cover that was requested prior to arrival were not provided. Unfortunately the cleaning solution used on the bedroom floor was also over-concentrated, leaving a very strong smell that did not dissipate after multiple days. That being said, the host did make strong, continued efforts to remedy these issues, bringing the requested supplies within 24 hours, and applying a small refund. The apartment itself is reasonably comfortable and well furnished, the bed is not great but everything is as represented in the photos. Overall, it could just use more detail-oriented maintenance with the issues I experienced and the cleanliness of the kitchen and other areas were not what I can truthfully call "5 Stars." The outstanding communication from the host and their commitment to try and create a positive experience was the biggest redeeming quality. Thank you, best wishes
